title: 2023年12月四级真题 第2套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
passage:
P1 A multitasker is one who can perform two or more tasks effectively at the same time, which— apart from the obvious differences—is similar to what a computer does. The concept does indeed come from the realms of technology, where it is used to refer to an operating system that can execute multiple tasks at the same time. However, the question is: can a person really be a multitasker?

P2 For most scientists, the answer is no. So much so that, according to experts in neuroscience(神经系统科学), our brains do not handle multitasking situations well. As soon as two tasks require our attention, productivity suffers. What we call multitasking, therefore, is in reality the ability to move more or less quickly from one task to another. This requires two essential conditions: that one of the tasks needs to be automatic, like walking or eating, and that they both need different mental processes. Answering the phone and writing at the same time, for example.

P3 However, on the other side of the coin there are people who maintain that it is possible to be, or at least seem to be, multitasking. A recent study concluded that regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not, the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance.

P4 The business perspective offers a different view: multitasking is understood as the ability to adapt to all types of environment within a company and effectively undertake different activities within a set time frame. Indeed, many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking to improve their productivity. From this different perspective, you can not only be multitasking but this ability can also be taught: something that is easier in fluid organisations, which favour flexibility in their working practices.

P5 The benefits of multitasking are clear. Being quicker and more efficient increases our performance and the number of tasks completed. But having to pay attention to several things at once means that the powers of concentration are reduced and that can lead to more mistakes.

questions.q: What does a "multitasker" originally refer to?
options: An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once.
A skilled worker executing more than one task at the same time.
A sophisticated technology doing several tasks effectively at once.
An efficient person able to perform multiple tasks at the same time.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does a "multitasker" originally refer to 直接问一个词「原本指什么」，考的 是文中对该词来源含义的界定。

【拆句】句子主干是 What does a "multitasker" originally refer to，结构平铺，refer to 意为「指 代、指的是」，originally 作状语修饰 refer to，意为「最初指的是」。无陷阱。 51. What does a "multitasker" originally refer to? A) An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once. B) A skilled worker executing more than one task at the same time. C) A sophisticated technology doing several tasks effectively at once. D) An efficient person able to perform multiple tasks at the same time.

【定位】The concept does indeed come from the realms of technology, where it is used to refer to an operating system that can execute multiple tasks at the same time. 这个概念确实来自科技领域，在那里它被用来指一种能够同时执行多项任务的操作系统。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 an operating system that can execute multiple tasks at the same time ↔ An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once 预判要的「能同时多任务的操作系统」与 An operating system capable of doing several tasks at once 完全吻合，主体、能力、同时性三点都对上。 B) 偷换概念 A skilled worker（熟练工人）把主体说成人，而原词最初指的是操作系统，主体张冠 李戴。 C) 偷换概念 A sophisticated technology（一种复杂技术）只取了原文「来自科技领域」的背景， 却没说成「操作系统」，主体被放大成笼统的「技术」，与原文具体所指不符。 D) 答非所问 An efficient person（高效的人）把主体说成人，对应的是首句对 multitasker 的「现 今」描述，而非题干要的「最初」所指，时间与主体都错。 根据神经科学家的观点,为什么人们实际上无法成为多任务处理者? A) 他们没有充分接触多任务处理的情境。 B) 他们无法与机械操作系统相比。 C) 他们的大脑不允许他们进行多任务处理。 D) 他们的注意力持续时间无法延长。

questions.q: Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists?
options: They are not sufficiently exposed to multitasking situations.
They are not comparable to mechanical operating systems.
Their brains do not allow them to multitask.
Their attention span cannot be expanded.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists 问的是某方 观点下的具体理由，答案能在原文直接找到对应句。

【拆句】Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists：主干是 why ... can't people be multitaskers（人为什么不能成为多任务者），really 加强语气， according to neuroscientists 是状语，限定「按神经科学家的看法」。really 易让人误读 为「真的能吗」，其实它服务于全句的否定，意为「人确实当不了」。

【定位】So much so that, according to experts in neuroscience(神经系统科学), our brains do not handle multitasking situations well. 以至于，按照神经科学专家的说法，我们的大脑并不能很好地处理多任务情境。 52. Why can't people really be multitaskers according to neuroscientists? A) They are not sufficiently exposed to multitasking situations. B) They are not comparable to mechanical operating systems. C) Their brains do not allow them to multitask. D) Their attention span cannot be expanded.

【选项】A) 无中生有 not sufficiently exposed to multitasking situations（接触多任务情境不够）文中从 未提及，原文讲的是大脑机能，不是接触多少。 B) 答非所问 not comparable to mechanical operating systems（无法与机械操作系统相比）只是 首段把人和电脑作类比的延伸，并非神经科学家给出的不能多任务的理由。 C) ✓ 正确 our brains do not handle multitasking situations well ↔ Their brains do not allow them to multitask 预判的「大脑处理不好」与 Their brains do not allow them to multitask 一致，把原 因归于大脑这一生理层面，正合定位句。 D) 无中生有 attention span cannot be expanded（注意力广度无法扩展）文中并无此说，原文只 说两项任务争夺注意力时效率下降，没谈注意力能否扩展。 从最近一项关于多任务处理的研究结论中我们了解到什么? A) 人们通过保持他们正在做的事情是多任务处理这一认知而取得更大成就。 B) 人们对他们正在做的事情作为多任务处理的感知使其表现受益。 C) 人们活跃的心理过程对他们的多任务处理产生积极影响。 D) 人们可以通过处理多任务处理情境来提高他们的能力。

questions.q: What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study on multitasking?
options: People make greater achievements by maintaining whatever they are doing is multitasking.
People's performance benefits from the perception of what they are doing as multitasking.
People's active mental processes exert a positive effect on their multitasking.
People can improve their capabilities by handling multitasking situations.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study 问一项具体研究的结论， 原文有对应明示句，属可直接定位的细节。

【拆句】What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study on multitasking：主干 what do we learn（我们了解到什么），from the conclusion of a recent study 是状语，on multitasking 修饰 study，指「一项关于多任务的近期研究的结论」。结构平铺，无陷阱。

【定位】A recent study concluded that regardless of whether people are actually handling several tasks or not, the mere fact that they perceive this activity as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance. 一项近期研究得出结论：无论人们是否真的在处理多项任务，仅仅是他们把这一活动感知为 多任务这个事实，就对他们的表现有正面影响。 53. What do we learn from the conclusion of a recent study on multitasking? A) People make greater achievements by maintaining whatever they are doing is multitasking. B) People's performance benefits from the perception of what they are doing as multitasking. C) People's active mental processes exert a positive effect on their multitasking. D) People can improve their capabilities by handling multitasking situations.

【选项】A) 偷换概念 maintaining whatever they are doing is multitasking 用 maintaining（坚持主张/坚 持做）替换原文的 perceive（感知），「坚称是多任务」不等于「感知为多任务」，把 主观认知偷换成口头主张。 B) ✓ 正确 they perceive this activity as multitasking ↔ the perception of what they are doing as multitasking has a positive effect on their performance ↔performance benefits from 预判的「感知为多任务即提升表现」与 People's performance benefits from the perception of what they are doing as multitasking 完全对应，落点都在「感知」这 一主观因素。 C) 张冠李戴 active mental processes（积极的心理过程）借的是第二段讲切换需要不同 mental processes 的内容，与本研究结论的「感知」无关。 D) 与原文相反 improve their capabilities by handling multitasking situations 说「靠处理多任务来 提升能力」，而原文强调的恰是「无论是否真在处理多任务」，重点在感知而非实际处 理，方向相反。 商业界如何看待多任务处理? A) 它是一种在灵活组织中常见的稀有技能。 B) 它是所有员工都需要具备的适应性能力。 C) 它是许多员工缺乏的一种基本素质。 D) 它是一种可以培养的理想能力。

questions.q: How does the business world view multitasking?
options: It is a rare skill often found in fluid organisations.
It is an adaptable capability required of all workers.
It is an essential quality many employees lack.
It is a desirable ability that can be developed.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 How does the business world view multitasking 问商业界如何看待多任务，原文有 专段陈述该立场，属可定位细节。

【拆句】How does the business world view multitasking：view 在此是动词「看待」，主干为 the business world view multitasking（商业界如何看待多任务）。需注意 view 此处不是 名词「景观」而是动词，属熟词的常见用法。

【定位】From this different perspective, you can not only be multitasking but this ability can also be taught: something that is easier in fluid organisations, which favour flexibility in their working practices. 从这一不同视角看，你不仅可以做到多任务，而且这种能力还可以被传授：这在灵活的组织 里更容易做到，这类组织在工作方式上崇尚灵活性。 54. How does the business world view multitasking? A) It is a rare skill often found in fluid organisations. B) It is an adaptable capability required of all workers. C) It is an essential quality many employees lack. D) It is a desirable ability that can be developed.

【选项】A) 与原文相反 a rare skill（罕见技能）与原文 many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking 矛盾——能被许多公司寻得且可传授，说明并不罕见。 B) 以偏概全 required of all workers（对所有员工的要求）把范围夸大成「全体员工」，原文只说 many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking，是企业青睐某些 人，而非要求所有人都具备。 C) 无中生有 many employees lack（许多员工缺乏）文中并无此说，原文谈的是公司想要、能力可 教，没有说员工普遍缺乏这种能力。 D) ✓ 正确 many companies look for people who are skilled in multitasking ↔a desirable ability this ability can also be taught ↔that can be developed 预判的「可培养的实用能力」与 a desirable ability that can be developed 两点全 中：desirable 对应被公司追求，can be developed 对应可教。 如果我们必须专注于某项任务并把它做好,作者暗示我们应该做什么? A) 以灵活的方式工作。 B) 从错误中学习。 C) 避免多任务处理。 D) 提高效率。

questions.q: What does the author imply we should do if we have to focus on some task and do it well?
options: Work in a flexible way.
Learn from mistakes.
Avoid multitasking.
Increase efficiency
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What does the author imply we should do 用 imply 问作者「暗示」我们该怎么 做，答案需基于原文推理而非直接摘录。

【拆句】What does the author imply we should do if we have to focus on some task and do it well：主干 what does the author imply we should do（作者暗示我们该做什么），if 引导条件状语从句 if we have to focus on some task and do it well（如果我们必须专注 某项任务并把它做好）。从句是答案成立的前提，须连同主句一起理解。

【定位】But having to pay attention to several things at once means that the powers of concentration are reduced and that can lead to more mistakes. 但不得不同时关注好几件事，意味着专注力会下降，而这会导致更多错误。 55. What does the author imply we should do if we have to focus on some task and do it well? A) Work in a flexible way. B) Learn from mistakes. C) Avoid multitasking. D) Increase efficiency

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 Work in a flexible way（以灵活方式工作）取自第四段商业视角的 favour flexibility in their working practices，与末段「要专注做好该怎么办」无关。 B) 无中生有 Learn from mistakes（从错误中学习）只是借了末段 mistakes 一词，原文说的是多任 务会「导致」更多错误，从未建议「从错误中学习」。 C) ✓ 正确 having to pay attention to several things at once means that the powers of concentration are reduced ↔Avoid multitasking 预判的「别同时做多件事」与 Avoid multitasking 一致——既然多任务降低专注、引发 错误，那要做好就该避免它。 D) 答非所问 Increase efficiency（提高效率）对应原文 Being quicker and more efficient，但那是 多任务的「好处」一面，并非「要专注做好」的对策；况且追求效率与多任务相伴，恰 是降低专注的根源。
